title: My BTC Cycle Model
description: A pre-registered, publicly graded model of where Bitcoin sits in its roughly four-year halving cycle. It publishes a projection fan (5/25/50/75/95% ranges) built from the model's own past forecast errors, a Cycle Heat Score built from public market, on-chain, usage, attention and halving-timing data, and a cycle band. Model versions are frozen with sha256 hashes and OpenTimestamps proofs before any result, every daily forecast is logged and graded in public against a plain power-law benchmark (exact binomial coverage tests and Diebold-Mariano tests), kill criteria for retiring a version are fixed in advance, and every variant tried is listed in RESEARCH_LOG.md. These are model ranges, not predictions, and not financial advice. Disclosure: the author holds Bitcoin-related investments.
